name: Firstseal Hold
description: Hold the foe under the first seal so no technique of any tier stirs in him.

name: Firstseal Cover
description: Spread the first seal over yourself and your allies as a cover of unbroken closure.

name: Firstseal Surge
description: Surge the first seal outward in a wave that locks and strikes every foe it reaches.

name: Firstseal Mend
description: Close the gravest wound under the first seal and keep it closed in yourself or an ally.

name: Firstseal Press
description: Press the first seal on the whole field so every foe's power is held at its lowest.

name: Firstseal Nullity
description: Close the user inside the first seal so no technique below its tier can reach him.

name: Firstseal Cleanse
description: Close a curse or taint inside the first seal and carry it out of yourself or an ally.

name: Firstseal Return
description: Hold the breath of one just fallen behind the first seal and restore it within the short window.

name: Firstseal Closing
description: The school's closing move that lays the first seal over the field with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Firstseal Edict
description: The school's edict move that stills every technique near the user for a span that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Firstseal Verdict
description: The school's judging move that seals one foe and closes the user against him with a force that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Firstseal Ruin
description: Let the first seal fall on the field as one closing mass at the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Unopened
description: Seal the foe's last loosed technique so completely that it is as if it had never been opened or cast.
